changelog: - **"Request this mentor" CTA** (#1773). The mentor directory card and a mentor's public profile now offer a signed-in mentee a direct "Request this mentor" link to `/portal?mentor=<id>`, which preselects that mentor in the mentorship request panel and confirms the choice above the form. The picker stays editable, an id that is not in the consent-gated directory list falls back to an empty picker plus a visible notice, and `POST /api/mentorship-requests` still re-validates the preferred mentor server-side.

en: Mentor directory cards and mentor profiles now have a "Request this mentor" button that takes you straight to the request form with that mentor already selected.
tr: Mentor dizini kartlarına ve mentor profillerine "Bu mentoru iste" düğmesi eklendi: seni doğrudan, o mentorun önceden seçili olduğu talep formuna götürür.
de: Mentorenkarten im Verzeichnis und Mentorenprofile haben jetzt die Schaltfläche "Diesen Mentor anfragen" — sie führt direkt zum Anfrageformular, in dem dieser Mentor bereits ausgewählt ist.
